title: confiture test-db status --format json
description: Whether a template database matches the current db/ content hash (TemplateStatus.to_dict). The exit code carries the verdict: 0 when state is current, 1 when stale or absent, and this shape is written in all three cases. A failure (no server, invalid name) writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead.

name.description: The template database name given as --template.

state.description: current: the stored hash equals current_hash. stale: the template is confiture-managed but was built from another db/ tree. absent: no database of that name, or one that carries no confiture template marker (it is not a usable template).

stored_hash.description: The hash stamped on the template's database COMMENT when it was provisioned; null when state is absent.

current_hash.description: The hash of the project now: the SHA-256 hex digest of the db/ tree that SchemaBuilder.compute_hash() returns. The command always computes one; null is reserved for a library caller that passes none.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
